title: Make space
description: Three oversized digital channels turn level, mute and solo into a graphic rhythm surface.
useCase: Expose the relationship between independent channels and a final composition in an audio tool or a layered visual editor.
interaction: Drag levels, mute channels, or isolate a solo
reducedMotion: Meter animation becomes a stable representative level while volume, mute and solo remain usable.
limitations: Visual control demo with synthetic meters and no sound. Wire levels to actual gain and meter values to an analyser; percentages are not a calibrated decibel scale.
look: Acid-lime page with three near-black fader wells striped by lime meter bars, small white rectangular handles, outlined square toggle buttons and plain sans-serif labels.
motion: Striped meters pulse within each fader's level on staggered 750–970 ms linear loops; dragging a fader sets its fill and handle position directly, and mute or solo hides meters.
adapt: Meters are `.sf-mix-signal` scaled by the `sf-mix-level` keyframes inside `.sf-mix-fill`, whose `scaleY` follows `levels`; `silent` derives from `muted` and `solo`. Replace `channels` and drive `levels` and meter scale from real gain and analyser values.
